_comment: Schema for data/pulse-threshold-validation.json — the INDEPENDENT validator's per-recommendation verdicts (Phase B of the threshold-evolution loop). Produced by a DIFFERENT model than the recommender (contract: automation/prompts/threshold-validation.md) in Perplexity Computer and ingested by editorial-runner --threshold-validate-ingest. Designed for an eventual N-model panel but ships single-validator. The deterministic gate requires verdict=support AND confidence>=validator_min_confidence AND would_cause_missed_signal=false.

model_used._comment: validator model id — MUST be a different provider than the recommender.

confidence._comment: Validator's confidence the rec is correct in direction AND magnitude given the evidence.

would_cause_missed_signal._comment: True if the validator judges this change would have suppressed a real, material signal. A true here is a hard veto at the gate.
